name: password-input-form
title: Password Input: Form
description: A sign-up form owned by TanStack Form. One Effect Schema checks the email, requires 8 characters and a number in the password, and adds a filter that places a mismatch on the confirmation through its `path`. Each password renders through `field.PasswordField`, and both share one visibility state, so either toggle shows the two passwords together. Showing a password with the pointer keeps focus in the input, so it does not mark the field touched. Submitting hides both passwords again.
